concerns.text: FR-002 mandates mapping based solely on 'vector norm > 0.5'. Tasks T005 and T011 implement a 'Composite Logic' adding a text keyword check ('collision'/'unsafe'). This deviates from the spec's deterministic rule, meaning the tasks do not cover the specific FR-002 requirement as written.

SC-001 requires measuring performance against an 'independent physics engine reward baseline'. Task T023 explicitly authorizes calculating a 'proxy from normalized action magnitude' if the native signal is missing. This task covers a fallback not defined in the spec, failing to cover the strict SC-001 requirement for an independent ground truth.

FR-006 requires categorizing errors into 'visual ambiguity', 'logical complexity', and 'context mismatch'. Task T026 redefines these categories to 'Action Noise', 'Context Mismatch', and 'Label Ambiguity' based on proxy metrics. The specific failure modes required by FR-006 are not covered by the tasks.

FR-003 requires training 'a lightweight... proxy model' (singular). Task T012 instructs implementing 'TWO distinct DistilBERT models' (Hard and Soft). The task covers a scope (dual models) not present in the spec, leaving the specific single-model requirement of FR-003 unaddressed.

FR-004 requires evaluation on a 'physical control test set' using independent physics engine scores. Tasks T018/T019 describe evaluating on a 'continuous test set' derived from the unified dataset without explicitly validating a distinct physical control ground truth. The specific requirement for an independent physical test set is not clearly covered.

Tasks T003/T004 reference 'google-research/bridge-data' with config 'bridge_v2', while the Plan and Spec (updated for Bridge) reference 'bridge-to-worlds/bridge-data'. The task tags/descriptions contain stale or incorrect dataset identifiers compared to the current plan/spec.
